content:
We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra or NMR to infer carbonyls. But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is "the compound at hand" which is implicit. We need to determine carbonyl count. Likely we need to use IR spectra to see C=O stretch. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get spectrum, then count peaks in carbonyl region. That is cheap? It's a measurement but okay.

We can call carbon_nmr_spectra.
